nodes.description: Germline heterozygous missense variants at RIPK1 residue D324 (D324N, D324H, D324Y, D324V; also neighbouring L321 and D324 substitutions) prevent caspase-8 from cleaving RIPK1 at this site, which separates the kinase domain from the intermediate and death domains.
